query: Our new office manager is taking over the monthly reports and asked me what EBITDA is. Can you give me a simple explanation I can pass on to her, with a quick example using a small bakery's numbers?
bond prices fall when interest rates rise... why?? explain like I'm 5, every finance podcast acts like it's obvious
my 6 year old asked why sunsets are orange if the sky is blue. what do I tell her?

I just started a job that pays partly in RSUs, and my first vesting statement says 41 shares vested and 15 were "withheld for taxes". Investing is totally new to me. Can you explain how RSUs get taxed and why they kept shares instead of just taking cash out of my paycheck?
The blood pressure machine at the pharmacy gave me 142/91. Can you explain in simple words what the top and bottom numbers mean, and whether that counts as high?

my mom's echo report says this and she's panicking:

Mild left ventricular hypertrophy. Trace mitral regurgitation, likely physiologic. Ejection fraction 60%. No pericardial effusion.

can you explain what it means in a way that's easy to understand? she's going to read your answer too
read NASA's article on the Webb telescope 3 times and I'm still lost. what does "redshifted" light actually mean, and how does that tell them the light is 13 billion years old?

my dad (78) just got diagnosed with atrial fibrilation and came out of the cardiologist more confused than when he went in. she kept saying "stroke risk" and "anticoagulation". what is afib really, and why does it mean he has to go on a blood thinner? he never finished high school and hates being talked down to

The outlet in our bathroom with the little TEST and RESET buttons cuts out every time my wife uses her hair dryer. I've never touched a breaker panel in my life. What is that outlet actually doing, and why would a hair dryer set it off?

Tomorrow I have to tell our food bank volunteers why we're switching to tracking donations by lot number. Most of them are retirees and high school kids who just want to sort cans. What is lot tracking, said in a way that will land with that crowd, and why does it matter when there's a recall?

trying to show my 16yo why he should put some of his summer job money in a Roth IRA. can you make a chart of $2,000/yr at 7% starting at 16 vs starting at 30, and explain compound growth in a way a teenager will actually follow?

My son's 4th grade science fair project is "Why does ice float?" Help us lay out the poster: a title, 3-4 short sections, and an explanation of density he can say out loud to the judges in his own words.
Explain how revenue-based financing differs from venture debt: repayment mechanics, typical return caps, and the covenants each one usually carries.
how does a backdoor Roth conversion work, and when does the pro-rata rule bite if I still have a rollover IRA with pre-tax money in it?
Explain how the Coriolis effect sets the spin direction of hurricanes, and why they almost never form within about 5 degrees of the equator.
Explain optimistic vs pessimistic locking in Postgres, and when SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED is the right choice for a job queue table.

explain what this line does and why it's wrapped in useMemo:

const debouncedSave = useMemo(() => debounce(save, 500), [save]);

Draft a single slide for Thursday's design review explaining why we moved the live scoreboard from REST polling to websockets: about 40% fewer requests, p95 latency down from 900ms to 120ms, roughly $200/month more in connection costs.

Put together an agenda for next Tuesday's 60-minute internal medicine journal club: two papers (GLP-1 agonists and kidney outcomes; CGM accuracy in ICU patients), a 10-minute resident case presentation, and 5 minutes for next month's sign-ups.

need a 2-bullet summary of this abstract for my lab notebook:

We randomized 412 adults with stage 1 hypertension to a sodium-restricted diet (<1,500 mg/day) or their usual diet for 12 weeks. Mean systolic blood pressure fell 6.1 mmHg in the intervention group versus 1.2 mmHg in controls (p<0.001). The effect was larger in participants aged 60 and older. No serious adverse events occurred.

make this text to my landlord more formal, I want it to sound like I mean business: hey so the heat's been out since tuesday and it's like 50 degrees in here at night. I've texted you twice already. if it's not fixed by friday I'm calling the city housing office.

translate this note from my son's school into Vietnamese for my mom, she does Friday pickup:

Starting next week, Friday dismissal will be at 1:30 pm instead of 3:00 pm. Students in the after-school program will stay until 5:00 pm as usual. Picture day has moved to November 19.

can u check the grammar on this before I send it to the team? leave my phrasing alone otherwise: Heads up, the quarterly numbers is in the shared drive. Revenue were up 8% but margins dipped because of the freight costs we talked about last month. Me and Dana will explain the details on Thursdays call.

explain what Dickinson is doing with the carriage ride in this stanza. is the speaker actually calm about death, or is "kindly" ironic?

Because I could not stop for Death -
He kindly stopped for me -
The Carriage held but just Ourselves -
And Immortality.
